messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — enterprise customers reported more 95th pct latency spikes this morning. They were on the eu-central region on the v2-small model. Can we sketch a short-term routing + fallback change that keeps p95 < 250ms for enterprise but doesn't crater lower tiers?

Kenji Sato: Thanks. Quick datapoint: infra spikes coincided with a GC storm on a few hosts, and we saw p95 jump to ~1.1s for ~2m windows. Error rate stayed low. Suggestion: hedged requests for enterprise + quick fallback to quantized v2-small-q8 when p95 > 500ms for >30s.

Samir Patel: I like hedging but we need to guard cost and quotas. Propose policy: route primary -> regional preferred pool; if latency SLO breached, spawn hedged request to cheaper variant (q8) but limit hedges to X rps per tenant and only for premium tiers. Also add a circuit-breaker that opens if p95 > 800ms or 5xx rate > 2% for 1m. Pseudoconfig: 
```
routing_policy: 
  tiers: 
    enterprise:
      latency_slo_ms: 250
      hedged: 
        enabled: true
        max_hedges_per_min: 60
        fallback_model: v2-small-q8
      circuit_breaker: 
        open_if_p95_ms: 800
        open_if_error_rate_pct: 2
        cool_down_s: 60
```

Tasha Nguyen: UX/console questions: how do we surface this so support can explain rollouts? We should show a timeline for when hedges were triggered, per-tenant hedged count, and cost impact estimate. Also allow a one-click rollback to disable hedging per customer.

Maria Chen: Agreed on telemetry. Minimal goals: per-tenant p95, hedged_count, fallback_rate, cost_estimate in the last 1h. Also need alerting thresholds: notify on >5% of enterprise tenants using hedges for >10m.

Kenji Sato: For telemetry we can add a new metric stream from the router: hedged_attempts{tenant,region,model}, fallback_success{tenant,variant}, hedge_latency_ms. We should sample full traces for 1% of hedged requests so SRE can inspect fallback quality.

Samir Patel: API implications: small change to /route decision API to return decision metadata to caller (route_id, fallback_used, hedge_spawned). Minimal contract: 
```json
{"route_id":"r-abc123","model":"v2-small","fallback":"v2-small-q8","hedge":true}
```
This helps product teams correlate user-visible behavior with policy. We should default to not exposing fallback details on public hosted API unless tenant opts in.

Tasha Nguyen: For rollout: canary to 5% of enterprise tenants for 24h, with automatic rollback if median cost per token > +20% or if any tenant sees p95 degrade > 15%. Console should show toggle and a per-tenant override list.

rb-routing-bot: deploy queued: routing-policy/v0.41 -> staging. CI: 8 checks passed. ETA 12m.

Maria Chen: Next steps: Samir to draft policy DSL + API change; Kenji to add router telemetry hooks and sampling; Tasha to mock console panels and per-tenant toggle; I'll coordinate canary list and post customer comms. Ping here when PRs are ready. :thumbsup:
